title: Discovered Check Wins the Queen
setup: The black queen on e5 is checking your king down the e-file. Your knight on c6 stands between your bishop on a4 and Black's king.
hint: The knight is blocking a check of your own. Move it somewhere it does real work.
explanation:
## The Idea

Your king is in check, and the answer is a counterattack. The knight on c6 is blocking your bishop's diagonal to e8.

{{Nxe5+}} takes the checking queen, and moving the knight uncovers check from the bishop. {{Kd8}}, {{Kf8}} and {{Ke7}} are Black's only moves, and none of them reaches the knight.

When your piece stands between your long-range piece and the enemy king, every move it makes comes with check.
